parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The filter conditions for the query. Multiple conditions are evaluated by using a logical AND.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **100**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the WAF instance. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: The Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-security-event-logs --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --filter '{"DateRange":{"StartDate":1713888000,"EndDate":1713888600},"Conditions":[{"OpValue":"eq","Values":"test.waf-top","Key":"matched_host"}]}' --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
